title: Continuous Reflection Daemon, JUnit Test Trajectory Harvesting & CI Distillation
author: Brain Harness Autobiographical Reflection Engine (harness-reflector)
context: In autonomous agent harnesses, execution knowledge is often lost as ephemeral residue once a process exits. When CI runs execute test suites, rich diagnostics (failures, errors, and fixes) are discarded upon runner shutdown. Manually running reflection CLI commands is insufficient for unattended multi-day developmental velocity.
distilled_learning: # Continuous Reflection Daemon, JUnit Test Trajectory Harvesting & CI Distillation

claims.assertion: ReflectionDaemonWorker executes recurring autobiographical distillation loops in background tasks.
TestExecutionPatternExtractor parses JUnit XML test failure trajectories into verifiable Knowledge Items.
CI pipeline invokes harness reflect with --test-report flag for automated post-test distillation.
